reminders.heading: Source drawing says
reminders.text: STR-02 shows Ø8 @125 mm at the plinth zone; STR-06 explicitly shows Ø10 @100 mm beside its right-hand column. Preserve both until reconciled.

reminders.heading: Owner chooses a scenario
reminders.text: Two footing mats; M25 as the report material scenario; Soil Type A only as an unverified assumption; a 16,000-L tank target and a five-storey flat-roof interpretation.

reminders.heading: Code checks and site evidence decide
reminders.text: STR-15 already contains a smaller tank and reinforcement drawings. Verified foundation geometry, geotechnical evidence, dimensional tank redesign and professional review remain required.

versionRule: Original Drive source IDs do not change. Archive PRE before edits; edit live IDs; verify POST and Git PR; preserve release tags. A7 links but never duplicates owner CAD engineering data.
